summary: Keep scenario conversation followers live when a known running agent has not created its first thread

replay.detail: No daemon claim replay or recovery changes. Scenario replay resolves pending conversations from the current roster, returns an empty successful snapshot and follows later entries; HTTP timeline reads use the same identity.

compatibility.detail: Existing conversation frame shapes and published session identities are unchanged. Unknown agents and sessions remain terminal not-found.

downtime.detail: No service deployment or interruption required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or recovery restrictions.
